population: All men's regular J1 fixtures in each half-open Beijing interval on the retained season schedule. Retain cancellations, postponements, missing issues, missing price sides and unresolved results with original slots. If subsequently added fixtures make the registration incomplete, disclose the coverage difference and do not certify that window.
author_method: Freeze both live registry engines for the same verified fixture. Use their original matrices, recent process and goal paths, venue, available team information and actual price to write one comprehensive first score and two distinct ordered alternatives. Record the argument and counterevidence for score, WDL and the quoted total. WDL and totals are separate decisions. Freeze the authored rows and the entire displayed batch before its earliest kickoff. Use the original publication only, with first visible proof and checked 90-minute result. Record any prior version and never reassign its slot.
selection: Each window is one predeclared analysis batch. Rank all issued eligible authored first scores using the geometric mean of the two native models' probabilities of that actual chosen score. Break equal probabilities by kickoff then match ID. Freeze up to three eligible different fixtures before the earliest kickoff in the entire window. Show both fewer-than-three coverage and all complete-batch denominators; no replacements.
market: At each authored issue use a same-book, same-cutoff 1X2 and actual total as available. For a paired quote, infer the market score distribution using the project's quote_only_matrices. Keep separate components when prices are missing. Strict total requires a dated provider quote and observed timestamp, named institution, real line and both prices, at most 3600 seconds from the selection cutoff. Also show observed-only prices and their settlements separately. A push is excluded from wins/nonpush; half-win, half-loss and full loss stay in the denominator.
stopping: Report both windows in order and combined, whether successful or not. Apply all four numeric stage thresholds and 100 percent complete selected-three sweeps in each window. Require all registered fixtures adjudicated, first message readback and coverage minima independently per window. When any condition is unmet, report the individual metrics and reason. No sample-dependent extension, early stopping, artificial promotion, or applying this J1 sample to other competitions. A timestamped data PR preserves independent evidence that the published text was available. Channel-specific certification still uses the genuine original delivery evidence.
